transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi, Dr. ____. Um... well, I guess I'm just having some trouble at work lately. It's... anything that takes real sitting-down brain work, you know? Like, doing the monthly reports or trying to plan out those multi-site health events we do. It just feels like I hit a wall. I keep putting it off, even when I know it matters. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Did you have similar trouble focusing or staying organized when you were a child?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... back in elementary school, the teachers used to tell my parents I was bright, but... I was just always daydreaming. I'd lose my worksheets a lot. And, uh... I usually forgot to turn in my homework unless my mom went through my backpack every night to check.
Do you often feel restless or like you have to keep moving, even when you’re supposed to sit still?
Um... no, not really. I don't feel like I need to keep moving or anything. Sitting still is fine.
Before age 12, did you often have trouble paying attention in class?
I don't really remember. I mean, I guess I already said I was daydreaming a lot back then... but I don't know if I'd call it trouble paying attention. It was just... a long time ago.
Do you often interrupt people or blurt out answers before they finish asking?
Um... no. I don't really do that. I usually just wait for people to finish.
Do you often fidget, squirm, or feel physically restless when you have to sit still?
No... I think you already asked me something like that. I don't really have a problem sitting still.
Do you often have trouble sustaining your attention on tasks like reports or planning work?

Yeah... I guess that's actually the main reason I'm here. Um. If it takes real sitting-down brain work... like doing the monthly reports, or planning a multi-site health event... I just kind of hit a wall. I keep putting it off, even when I know it matters.
Do you often feel unusually restless or like you need to move around even when you’re expected to sit still?
No. Um... like I just said, I don't really have that issue. Sitting still is fine.
Were these attention and organization problems also happening at home or in other settings when you were a child?

Yeah... I suppose so. Um... even back in elementary school, my teachers would tell my parents I was bright, but... just always daydreaming. I'd lose worksheets a lot. And I usually forgot to turn in my homework... at least, unless my mom checked my backpack every night. So... yeah.
Do you often make careless mistakes when you’re doing work or other tasks that require close attention?

Yeah, sometimes. Um... I guess I'll send out a clinic staffing schedule, or... an email for my son's soccer league, and I think I've checked it. But then... somebody points out I put the wrong date, or left off a location. Just... missing details I probably should have caught.
Do you often feel fidgety or like you need to move your hands or feet when you have to sit still?
No. Like I mentioned before... sitting still isn't really a problem for me. I don't feel fidgety.
Do you often lose things that are important for work or daily tasks, like keys, paperwork, or your phone?
No, not really. Um... I usually keep track of my keys and phone fine. It's... not something I've noticed being an issue.
Do you often get distracted by noises or activity around you when you’re trying to focus?

Yeah... I guess I do. Um... like in meetings at the clinic. If I'm trying to listen to a budget update, and... a phone vibrates, or people are talking out in the hall... it pulls me away. Or even just... a random thought about something I forgot for the league. I'll just sort of... realize I missed the last few minutes of what was said.
Do you often have trouble finishing tasks once the hardest part is done?
No... not really. Um, if the hard part is over, I just finish it. I haven't really noticed an issue with that.
Do you often act without thinking, like making impulsive decisions or doing things on the spur of the moment?
No, not really. Um... I usually think things through before I make a decision. I don't really do things on the spur of the moment.
Do you often feel unusually restless inside, even if you don’t move around much?
No, not really. I mean... I don't think so. I don't really feel that way.
Do you often fidget with your hands or feet when you have to sit still?
No. I don't really do that. I just sit still, usually.
Do you often have trouble waiting your turn?
No, I don't think so. I can wait fine.
Do you often talk more than other people expect you to?

I guess... maybe sometimes. Mostly just if I... if I make a mistake. Like if I drop the ball on a schedule at work, I might get a little nervous and over-explain it. I'll just sort of keep talking, even after the other person clearly got the point. But... yeah, just then.
When you were a child, did teachers or your parents describe you as very fidgety or always on the go?
No, not really. I was... pretty quiet back then. I don't remember anyone saying that about me.
